decisions.reason: As a newly launched core product line in underground mining that fits the firm's engineering, safety and service capabilities, there is no clear evidence of performance falling below aspiration levels yet, so boundedly rational management would likely keep it while results accumulate.

This new underground mining truck line is strategically close to the firm's specialized equipment business and likely benefits from shared capabilities and customer relationships, so absent clear underperformance management would probably retain it, though with slightly more uncertainty while market acceptance is proven.
